input.quote: HDI shall design, develop, implement, operate, maintain and manage, and enable the Company to establish a presence on the World Wide Web
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no ownership or assignment provision at all: HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (Sections 1.1–1.3) using Content we supply (Section 2.1), and customer orders and e-mail lists are generated through the Site (Sections 2.2, 7.1), yet nothing states who owns the Site, the developed work product or the customer/transaction data. The only IP-adjacent terms are a limited licence of our Marks to HDI (Section 6.1) and mutual confidentiality (Section 8), neither of which allocates ownership or gives us a licence back to HDI-developed Site materials. With no usable clause anywhere, the rule's preferred and fallback positions are both unmet, so we propose inserting a standard ownership clause: we own the Site, Content, Marks and customer data, HDI retains its pre-existing platform, tools and know-how with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to us for embedded HDI materials, and no joint ownership is created.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Site (including its design, look and feel, and all HTML, graphics, text and other materials developed by or for HDI specifically for the Site), (ii) the Content and the Marks, and (iii) all customer, order, transaction and user data collected through or generated by the Site, including customer e-mail lists relating to Deerskin Products (collectively, the "Company Data"). HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in the foregoing. HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing software, hosting platform, tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, modify and exploit any such HDI materials embedded in or necessary to operate the Site. Nothing in this Agreement shall create joint ownership of, or assign to HDI any right, title or interest in, the Site, the Content, the Marks or the Company Data.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership even though HDI develops and hosts the Site with our Content and collects our customer data, so we have added a clause confirming that we own the Site, Content, Marks and customer data while HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and grants us a perpetual licence to anything of its own embedded in the Site. This reflects our position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, and avoids any joint ownership.
proposal.summary: Add ownership clause: Company owns Site, Content, Marks and customer data; HDI retains background IP and grants a perpetual licence; no joint ownership.
